lessons.title: Story Time: A Shopping Trip Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss events involving money in a story.
success_criteria: I can say what was bought.
I can say how much change was given.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss a time children went shopping.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story involving a shopping trip, modelling discussion of the money used.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer questions about the money events in the story.
key_questions: How much change did they get?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of money events in a story — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a shopping trip with your family.

lessons.title: Giving Change from £1
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to work out change from £1.
success_criteria: I can subtract to find change.
I can check my change is correct.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model working out change from £1 using subtraction.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve change problems from £1, showing working.
key_questions: How did you work it out?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record giving change skill, extending from Year 1's introduction — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise working out change from £1 with play or real coins.

lessons.title: Writing About a Shopping Trip
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a recount of a shopping trip using the past tense.
success_criteria: I can write what I bought.
I can use the past tense consistently.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a recount of a shopping trip using consistent past tense.
lessons.independent_task: Children write a short recount of a real or imagined shopping trip.
key_questions: Is your writing in the past tense?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write 4+ sentences with varied past tense verbs

lessons.assessment_notes: Note recount writing with tense consistency — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about a shopping trip.

lessons.title: Giving Change from £2 and £5
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to work out change from £2 and £5.
success_criteria: I can find change from £2.
I can find change from £5.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model working out change from £2 and £5 using subtraction.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve change problems from £2 and £5, showing working.
lessons.assessment_notes: Record extending change-giving skill to larger amounts — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise working out change from £2 or £5 together.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Change and Shop Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read change/shop-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read shop words.
I can read a sentence about shopping.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to shop-themed words (e.g. 'shop', 'buy', 'change').
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading shop words over the week.

lessons.title: Two-Step Money Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve two-step word problems involving money.
success_criteria: I can find a total cost.
I can then work out the change.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap two-step word problems from Week 9.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving a two-step money problem: first finding total cost, then working out change.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve two-step money word problems, showing each step.

differentiation.support: Solve with adult support, breaking down each step
differentiation.greater_depth: Solve independently and explain both steps

lessons.assessment_notes: Record two-step problem solving applied to money, a challenging Year 2 objective — evidence for MATHS.N2/MEA.
lessons.home_link: Make up a two-step money word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Shop Role-Play: Giving Change
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to role-play giving correct change in a shop scenario.
success_criteria: I can work out and give the correct change.
I can use polite shop language.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the shop role-play from Week 33.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model a shop role-play including working out and giving change politely.
lessons.independent_task: Children take turns as shopkeeper and customer, practising giving correct change.
key_questions: How much change do you need to give?

differentiation.support: Adult supports change calculation during role-play

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and practical money skill combined — evidence for ENG.SL1/MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Play shop with your family, practising giving change.

lessons.title: Shop Till Data: Recording Transactions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to record simple shop transactions in a table.
success_criteria: I can record an item, cost and change in a table.
I can total the table.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recording shop transactions (item, cost, amount paid, change) in a simple table.
lessons.independent_task: Children record several transactions from their role-play in a table, totalling amounts.
key_questions: What was bought? What was the change?

differentiation.greater_depth: Complete a detailed table and calculate totals independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note data recording applied to a practical money context — evidence for MATHS.STAT/MEA.
lessons.home_link: Record a real or pretend shopping transaction at home.

lessons.title: Giving Change Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about giving change.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about shopping and change, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: How much change should be given here?
Why is it important to check your change?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on giving change.

lessons.title: Money Unit Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise and apply all money skills learned across the two-week unit.
success_criteria: I can recognise coins and notes.
I can total amounts and give change.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole money unit (recognition, totalling, change).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the unit's core money skills.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comprehensive mixed review covering the unit's key money skills.

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End of Money unit consolidation summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA/N2.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising money skills over the weekend.
